## What I Build
1. AI-Powered ATS with Twilio AI Calling: Real-time autonomous phone interviews screening candidates, transcripts, resume scoring, hiring pipeline.
2. Multi-Tenant CRM: Enterprise sales pipeline, leads attribution, per-tenant database isolation, duplicate detection.
3. Smart Email / Campaign Studio: AI-generated emails, audience segmentation, spam deliverability testing.
4. E-commerce Platforms: Custom storefronts, checkout, multi-inventory admin backends.
5. E-commerce Scrapers & Price Intelligence: High-throughput Puppeteer scrapers, catalog diffs, automated price tracking.
6. AI Chatbots & RAG Assistants: Grounded enterprise assistants built with LangGraph multi-step reasoning and tool execution.
7. Custom Web Applications: End-to-end web apps tailored to client workflows with modern architecture.
